description: Run a PromQL query against any Prometheus-compatible server's HTTP API and return results as a DataFrame. Works against open-source Prometheus, Cortex, Thanos, Mimir, VictoriaMetrics, Azure Managed Prometheus, Grafana Cloud.

server_url.description: Prometheus base URL (no trailing slash), e.g. 'https://prometheus.demo.do.prometheus.io', 'https://my-managed-prometheus.eastus.prometheus.monitor.azure.com', 'http://localhost:9090'
server_url.label: Server Url

range_query.description: False (default): instant query at time 'now' (single value per series). True: range query (returns a time series per matching series).
range_query.label: Range Query

range_seconds.description: Range duration in seconds (only used when range_query=true). Default: last hour.
range_seconds.label: Range Seconds

step_seconds.description: Step (sample interval) in seconds for range queries. Default: 60s.
step_seconds.label: Step Seconds

bearer_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a Bearer token for Authorization header. Required for Azure Managed Prometheus, Grafana Cloud, and any auth-protected server. For Azure Managed Prometheus: az account get-access-token --resource https://prometheus.monitor.azure.com
bearer_token_env_var.label: Bearer Token Env Var

extra_headers.description: Optional headers (e.g. X-Scope-OrgID for Cortex/Mimir tenants)
extra_headers.label: Extra Headers

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds
